newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.

text.p: Twelve stocks rose, two fell and seven were flat in 5.4-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Thursday with the WIG 20 index down one percent to 1,477 points.
In comparison with their main market fixing 15 stocks fell and six were flat.
The remaining nine stocks did not trade.
NFI units were flat at 126.5 zlotys in a 12.9-million-zloty turnover.
The National Investment Fund NIF index fell 1.5 percent to 128.6 points in 2.6-million-zloty trade.
